scope: Deterministic local publication transport contracts; no cloud or archive latency claim

native_chunk_wave.failure_contract: drain children, release metadata, restore CPU before returning backend error

text file, segment, routing, and checkpoint directories
tree_publication.private_metadata_reclamation: retire consumed runs after forest commit; recycle shared extents

text_publication.partial_upload_failure: drain children before returning; no directory published

compaction_and_projection.serving_directory_delta_order: addition-priority private runs; one application per prior root
compaction_and_projection.speculative_oom_after_headroom_recovers: drain, resume CPU, check cancellation, retry required read
compaction_and_projection.typed_projection_reference_segment_ident: equal across schema, selected-field, stored-source and borrowing modes
compaction_and_projection.canonical_replay_quota_fallback: complete prefix replayed; remaining manifests fetched normally
compaction_and_projection.prefetch_retained_memory: independent node reservation held until join or cancellation
compaction_and_projection.canonical_replay_write_failure: discard partial cache and use authenticated artifacts
compaction_and_projection.canonical_replay_decode_oom: reset partial decode, discard cache, retry authenticated artifacts with identical root
compaction_and_projection.compaction_output: buffered native SegmentSink to private spill; no contiguous output
compaction_and_projection.canonical_replay_consumers: canonical metadata reduction and serving compaction, independent order
compaction_and_projection.canonical_encoder_handoff: one encoded chunk transferred with ownership; no segment-array or payload copy
compaction_and_projection.native_term_statistics: bounded side channel during initial writing and merges; final output only
compaction_and_projection.statistics_flush: checkpoint boundary or pressure threshold; no forced per-file run
compaction_and_projection.captured_statistics_ordering: native per-field term order; sort compact field directory only
compaction_and_projection.fresh_summary_contributions: synchronous borrowed records copied into bounded DF and term-directory reducers
compaction_and_projection.recovered_summary_contributions: authenticated durable page cursor; no local recovery dependency
compaction_and_projection.optional_summary_quota_failure: release partial capture and replay completed native reader
compaction_and_projection.cross_file_merge_quota_failure: split cohort and reuse unchanged remote inputs
compaction_and_projection.encoder_lookahead_failure: cancel and drain child before releasing borrowed projection or spill manager
encoder_lookahead_identity_matrix: spill lookahead with one I/O lane
compaction_and_projection.optional_summary_and_required_segment_qu: independent pools within unchanged total caps
